meta.scope: ARCC Q2 2026 earnings, balance sheet, risk grades, non-accruals, and reconciled Schedule of Investments.

headline.stance: incremental credit softening; earnings and liquidity remain intact
headline.summary: NII still covered the regular dividend, but NAV fell, Core EPS sat just below the payout, and both non-accrual and lower-grade exposure increased. The Schedule of Investments shows the deterioration is concentrated in a finite group of credits rather than a portfolio-wide collapse.
